FIELD.NAME: course
FIELD.COMMENT: Course playervideo activity belongs to

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: name field for moodle instances

FIELD.NAME: intro
FIELD.COMMENT: General introduction of the playervideo activity

FIELD.NAME: introformat
FIELD.COMMENT: Format of the intro field

FIELD.NAME: videotype
FIELD.COMMENT: youtube | vimeo | html5

FIELD.NAME: videourl
FIELD.COMMENT: Video URL, when videotype is youtube or vimeo

FIELD.NAME: trimstart
FIELD.COMMENT: Playback window start, in seconds; null means from the beginning

FIELD.NAME: trimend
FIELD.COMMENT: Playback window end, in seconds; null means until the end

FIELD.NAME: showinline
FIELD.COMMENT: Pin the video inline on the course page, without hiding grade/attempts

FIELD.NAME: grademethod
FIELD.COMMENT: Grade aggregation across attempts: 1=highest, 2=average, 3=first, 4=last

FIELD.NAME: grade
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum grade; 0 means No grade (standard core convention)

FIELD.NAME: gradepass
FIELD.COMMENT: Minimum passing grade

FIELD.NAME: maxattempts
FIELD.COMMENT: Max attempts allowed (0 means unlimited)

FIELD.NAME: allowseekahead
FIELD.COMMENT: Disables the forward anti-skip restriction; rewind is always allowed either way

FIELD.NAME: hudcorrectitem
FIELD.COMMENT: block_playerhud item ID granted per correct answer (0 = unconfigured)

FIELD.NAME: hudretrycostitem
FIELD.COMMENT: block_playerhud item charged from the 2nd attempt onwards (0 = free)

FIELD.NAME: hudretrycostqty
FIELD.COMMENT: Quantity charged per retry

FIELD.NAME: completionallinteractions
FIELD.COMMENT: Custom completion rule: student must answer/view every interaction

FIELD.NAME: completionwatchtoend
FIELD.COMMENT: Custom completion rule: student must watch until the player's native ended event

TABLE.NAME: playervideo_progress
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-student playback progress, for resume and anti-skip validation

FIELD.NAME: playervideoid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to playervideo

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to user

FIELD.NAME: lastposition
FIELD.COMMENT: Seconds; used to resume playback

FIELD.NAME: watchedpct
FIELD.COMMENT: Percentage actually watched (0-100); input to the anti-skip check

FIELD.NAME: watchedtoend
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the player's native ended event already fired (completion rule 2)

FIELD.NAME: segments
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON of the second ranges actually watched

TABLE.NAME: playervideo_interactions
TABLE.COMMENT: Timestamp anchor pointing to a question in the Question Bank, or an inline note

FIELD.NAME: playervideoid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to playervideo

FIELD.NAME: timestamp
FIELD.COMMENT: Video second where the interaction fires

FIELD.NAME: type
FIELD.COMMENT: question | note

FIELD.NAME: weight
FIELD.COMMENT: Grading weight; only used when type is question

FIELD.NAME: questionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to the Question Bank question.id; null when type is note

FIELD.NAME: notetext
FIELD.COMMENT: Content shown when type is note; null when type is question

TABLE.NAME: playervideo_attempts
TABLE.COMMENT: One attempt of the activity by a student; multiple attempts allowed when maxattempts permits

FIELD.NAME: playervideoid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to playervideo

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to user

FIELD.NAME: attemptnumber
FIELD.COMMENT: 1st, 2nd, 3rd... attempt by this student on this instance

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: inprogress | pendingcorrection | finished; only finished feeds the Gradebook/grademethod

FIELD.NAME: grade
FIELD.COMMENT: This attempt's grade (weighted sum, see functional spec); only official once status is finished

FIELD.NAME: hudretrycharged
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the PlayerHUD retry cost was already charged for this attempt

TABLE.NAME: playervideo_responses
TABLE.COMMENT: Student response to one interaction, within one attempt

FIELD.NAME: playervideoid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to playervideo, avoids a join up to the interaction for reports

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to user

FIELD.NAME: attemptid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to playervideo_attempts

FIELD.NAME: interactionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to playervideo_interactions

FIELD.NAME: questionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Snapshot of the source Question Bank id, for audit if the interaction is later removed

FIELD.NAME: answerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to question_answers, when the response is multiple choice

FIELD.NAME: responsetext
FIELD.COMMENT: Free-text response, when the interaction is an open question

FIELD.NAME: iscorrect
FIELD.COMMENT: Null until graded; 0/1 for multiple choice (automatic grading)

FIELD.NAME: hudrewarded
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the PlayerHUD item was already granted for this interactionid+student, across any attempt

FIELD.NAME: aigrade
FIELD.COMMENT: AI grade suggestion (open question), already within the question's weight; never the official grade

FIELD.NAME: aifeedback
FIELD.COMMENT: AI feedback suggestion (open question)

FIELD.NAME: teachergrade
FIELD.COMMENT: Teacher-confirmed grade (open question), the only one that counts officially

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: answered | viewed (note) | pending_ai | pending_review | graded

FIELD.COMMENT: manual | youtube | vimeo; informational only
